assets.name: 墙体
assets.prompt: Input image role: geometry reference showing existing top-down wall grid blocks. Create ONE SINGLE wall-block tile for ONE 32x32 game grid cell, based on the reference's individual square block. Output a square opaque RGB bitmap, ideally1024x1024, with one large plain square wall-top face filling almost the whole canvas. It must NOT contain a row of bricks, multiple tiles, running-bond masonry or a wall surface pattern. Match this geometry: full dark base fills all32x32 cell; one subtly rounded top cap inset about1px left/right and1px top, top cap height about26px; narrow darker solid bottom band about5px creates a shallow raised wall-block effect. Very small light line across top edge, subtle side bevel. Exact top-down 2D orthographic wall-cap icon, no isometric cube and no perspective. vanilla cream top, warm biscuit beige rim and muted caramel-gray bottom band. Cute cozy gentle cartoon art, simple matte flat colors, clean warm outlines, no spots, no grain, no realistic texture, no glossy candy reflections. Entire image must be filled and completely opaque RGB, including corner pixels outside the slightly rounded cap, where the darker base color fills in. No blank space, transparency, outer margin, shadow cast outside the block, labels, lettering, floor, plants or background scenery. This one square asset will be drawn once per wall grid cell to form horizontal walls, vertical walls and corners. Production asset snack_street/wall.

assets.name: 四格外围背景
assets.prompt: Create a COMPLETE FULLY OPAQUE RGB landscape image for the outside scenery of a cute cozy 2D cartoon cat game. Art direction: cheerful casual mobile game illustration, very cute rounded toy-like shop rooftops and round potted bushes, warm vanilla cream, pastel coral pink, butter yellow and mint green. Clean smooth color fills and simple bold friendly shapes, delicate warm colored outlines, a few broad soft highlights, no texture noise or realistic details. Exact straight overhead orthographic view, not isometric. Composition: 13:11 landscape rectangle, ideally 1664x1408. The entire background is fully painted cream-beige paving. All props are restricted to a narrow band along the outer four edges: cropped coral and honey-colored shop rooftops, small rounded mint and cream striped awnings, a few small delivery boxes, round terracotta pots with simple puffy mint shrubs. Props form a narrow border roughly 8% of image width on left/right and 9% of height on top/bottom. The central 84% width and82% height is continuous warm pale paving made of very simple softly rounded blocks. It is painted, NOT blank white, and NOT transparent; actual randomly generated gameplay will cover it later. Make the tiny perimeter charming and cozy like a toy neighborhood while center stays quiet. Keep props small enough to fit border. No faces, characters, lettering, grid overlay, horizon, sky, perspective, photographic material, grain, dense speckles, watercolor mottling, gritty wear, vignette, edge fading, transparency, rounded canvas corners or unpainted margins. All pixels solid opaque RGB. Full rectangular image.
